newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait index hits record high in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait index hits record high in active trade.

text.p: Year-end profit rises by firms listed on Kuwait's bourse drove the index up 48.9 points to 2,024 points peak in a busier week, analysts said on Thursday.
"Company results are the main reason for demand and price increase this week also," said and analyst.
Gainers led losers 33-15, while seven did not move, figures released by the Kuwait Stock Exchange on Thursday showed.

The daily average for value of traded shares rose to 40.2 million dinars ($133.1 million) during the week to Wednesday from 25.1 million. Volume increased to a daily average of 81.7 million shares from 81.7 million.
"The market (prices) traditionally rises during this period," said an analyst. "Trade could fall a little before the Eid al-Fitr holiday (marking the end of the Moslem fasting month)," he added.
Investment firms were the most active sector in terms of traded value with 55.8 million dinars, followed by property firms with 44.9 million and banks with 34.4.
